_comment: Published Tenstorrent + CPU device specs for the perf-vs-cost ($/throughput) Pareto. Every peak/price/TDP number is a PUBLISHED spec with a source. No on-workload Tenstorrent number is measured yet (no card) — the workload layer is PROJECTED from the documented model below and flagged `measured:false`; scripts/measure-tenstorrent-pareto.sh fills the MEASURED numbers once a card is present.
generated_note: Specs as of 2026-08. Sources are Tenstorrent's own product pages/newsroom and Intel ARK; the CPU peak is an AVX2 FP32 estimate (formula in `source`), since a consumer CPU has no dense low-precision matrix engine.

devices.label: Intel Core i9-14900K
devices.peak_source: AVX2 FP32 estimate: 8 P-cores x 32 FLOP/cycle x ~5.0 GHz all-core ~= 1.28 TFLOPS; TDP = PL2 253 W (Intel ARK); price = launch MSRP $589. A CPU has no dense low-precision matrix unit, so this is its FP32 peak.

devices.label: Tenstorrent Wormhole n150
devices.peak_source: Tenstorrent published: 262 FP8 TFLOPS @ 1 GHz, 72 Tensix cores, 108 MB SRAM, 12 GB GDDR6 @ 288 GB/s, 160 W TDP; price $999.

devices.label: Tenstorrent Wormhole n300
devices.peak_source: Tenstorrent published: 466 FP8 TFLOPS, 128 Tensix cores, 192 MB SRAM, 24 GB GDDR6 @ 576 GB/s, 300 W TDP; price $1399.

projection_model._comment: PROJECTED single-Tensix-baby-core throughput for the SCALAR LOGOS benchmark suite, from the measured i9 LOGOS throughput. Every parameter is stated; these are not measurements. The MEASURED layer replaces this once a card runs the emitted kernels.
projection_model.ipc_ratio_basis: in-order single-issue Tensix baby RISC-V vs the i9's wide OoO P-core (conservative 0.30x IPC).
projection_model.compute_baby_cores_basis: one general-compute baby core per Tensix used for the scalar suite (the other RISC-Vs are data-movement/unpack/pack); a card runs that many independent benchmark instances in parallel.
